rubrics.justification: The description is largely consistent with the image and stated 3AA grade: expanded blastocoel, visible ICM, cohesive peripheral TE, and thinned zona. Minor overcalls include asserting uniformly excellent TE and possible early hatching/herniation, which are not clearly evident from this single image.
It integrates age, prior live births/miscarriage, male factor context, endometrial thickness, BMI, ovarian response, and sperm parameters with embryo quality and prognosis in a comprehensive way.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, with probability estimates tied to morphology and patient factors. Minor issues include somewhat speculative adjustments for stress/sedentary lifestyle and a few unsupported mechanistic claims.

Core recommendations such as proceeding with SET and standard luteal support are guideline-consistent, but several suggestions are weakly evidence-based or not routinely recommended (ERA, uterine NK testing, thrombophilia/immunologic workup, routine CoQ10/acupuncture framing, broad PGT-A endorsement).
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, luteal support, follow-up, and future-cycle review. It is useful clinically, though some recommendations are more speculative than standard practice.
